zh-CN.title: 欢迎消息编辑进一步对齐聊天
items: 欢迎消息输入栏恢复聊天会话相同的圆角卡片、表情与附件布局
移除气泡旁的删除按钮，现在长按消息即可删除

en.title: Welcome message editing now better matches chat
items: The composer now uses the same rounded card, emoji, and attachment layout as chat
Per-bubble delete buttons are gone; long-press a message to delete it
